user.title: Add a V-Guard inverter
user.description: The inverter must be connected to the same MQTT broker as Home Assistant. See the README for the DNS redirect it needs.

pick_device.title: Choose an inverter
pick_device.description: Found {device_count} inverter(s) on the MQTT broker.

manual.title: Enter the inverter's serial number
manual.description: The serial number is the last part of the inverter's MQTT topic, after `device/dups/CE01/`.

data_description.model: The part of the topic before the serial number. CE01 for current inverters.

progress.discovering: Listening for V-Guard inverters on MQTT…

error.no_devices_found: No new V-Guard inverters were heard on MQTT. Check the DNS redirect, or enter the serial number.
error.invalid_serial: Serial number and model code may only contain letters and digits.

abort.already_configured: This inverter is already set up.
abort.mqtt_not_ready: Set up the MQTT integration first. The inverter talks to Home Assistant through it.
